newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Hashimoto not slated to meet at Denver G7.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Hashimoto not slated to meet at Denver G7.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will meet formally in Denver this Friday with the heads of state from Russia, France and Italy, but not from Japan, National Security Adviser Sandy Berger said on Monday.

"At this point, the three bilaterals (with Russia's Boris Yeltsin, France's Jacques Chirac and Italy's Romano Prodi) ... are the only three that are scheduled. It's conceivable that there may be others," Berger said at a news briefing.

Berger added that Clinton and Japan's Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto would have ample time to speak with each other in Denver during the three-day summit of the Group of Seven industrial powers, plus Russia.

"There's a lot of time for conversation that takes place sort of to and from and on the margins and I'm sure that the president and Prime Minister Hashimoto will talk during the summit. Whether there will be an acutally formal bilateral, I don't know at this point," Berger added.
